data.title: Colors — Beginner · Lesson 1
data.subject: colors
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Rain pattering on the window)

[Hook]
Red… Rojo
Blue… Azul
Let’s learn today… Aprendamos hoy
In the rain… Bajo la lluvia
Colors everywhere… Colores por doquier
Come and sing with me.

[Verse]
Waking up, it’s pouring down,
Gray skies… Cielos grises
But we’re painting smiles, not a frown.
Green… Verde
The trees outside are swaying slow.
Yellow… Amarillo
The sun will shine, I know.

[Hook]
Red… Rojo
Blue… Azul
Let’s learn today… Aprendamos hoy
In the rain… Bajo la lluvia
Colors everywhere… Colores por doquier
Come and sing with me.

[Verse]
Black… Negro
The clouds above, so big and wide.
White… Blanco
The little lights that glow inside.
A rainbow waits for us to see,
Colors in the air, can’t you feel the melody?

[Bridge]
Look around, what do you see?
A world of colors, wild and free.
Orange… Naranja
Purple… Morado
Every shade, a story told.
In this moment, let it unfold.

[Hook]
Red… Rojo
Blue… Azul
Let’s learn today… Aprendamos hoy
In the rain… Bajo la lluvia
